You’ve got a new car, it looks awesome… and you want to keep it that way… so, you need to figure out how to protect your new car paint. Below, find out how to protect new car paint with our ceramic paint protection.

Tint a Car is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network but we don’t just offer window tinting. We also offer state-of-the-art paint protection, paint protection film, car wraps & car care products. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and have stores located conveniently throughout Australia. All of our films (which are exclusive to us) are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Here is how to protect the paint of a new car:

EliteX Ceramic Paint Protection

EliteX ceramic paint protection not only offers superior paint protection for your car but also gives your car’s paint extra shine with a high gloss mirror finish. EliteX provides extreme hardness and ultimate durability (4 times more durable than any quartz based product) and will protect your car from:

  • Bird and bat droppings
  • Bugs and tree sap
  • Weather induced oxidisation
  • Fading and loss of gloss
  • Spills and stains

EliteX is tested, proven and globally certified to the stringent standards set out for Boeing compatible products. And, to give you the ultimate peace of mind, EliteX has a lifetime warranty and we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you’re not completely satisfied (we’ll remove the wrap and give you your money back. Must claim within 30 days of sale). You can also get EliteX with our 3, 6 or 12 months zero interest finance options through Zip Pay and Open Pay.

So, want to know how to protect the paint of a new car? EliteX is your answer!
